title: MEASUREMENT TOOLS — nominal to ratio, uniform to Cauchy, the math under the membrane

the_thesis.concept: every statistical concept is a MEASUREMENT TOOL. not abstract math — a tool you pick up and USE. like a wrench set: nominal is the label maker, ratio is the micrometer. you choose the tool for the job.
the_thesis.the_balance: the sigmoid sits at 50% (inflection). the anti-sigmoid dips at 85%. between them: the FULL toolkit of statistics. each tool measures where you are on that curve.

measurement_scales.concept: Stevens (1946): 4 levels. each level unlocks more operations. nominal is weakest. ratio is strongest.

nominal.what: NAMES. categories. labels. no order, no distance, no zero.
examples: plate: chalk, pumice, granite, basalt, diamond
nominal.tool_analog: the LABEL MAKER. it tells you WHAT something is. not how much.
nominal.membrane_use: primal-taxonomy.json genus classification. ghost-taxonomy.json type counts. feed strata names.

ordinal.what: RANKS. ordered categories. has direction, no consistent distance.
examples: evolution stage: imagined < coded < compiled < deployed < classified < enmeshed < evolved
plate hardness: chalk < pumice < slate < limestone < granite < basalt < obsidian < iron < diamond
valley depth: shallow < moderate < deep < critical
ordinal.tool_analog: the RANKING BOARD. it tells you WHICH is more. not by how much.
ordinal.membrane_use: feed-taxonomy.json health tiers. evolution stages. priority sorting.

interval.what: DISTANCES. equal spacing. has meaningful differences. NO true zero.
examples: Shannon entropy bits (0 bits = certain, but concept of "no entropy" is philosophical)
anti-sigmoid comfort score (-0.4 to 1.0, zero is arbitrary)
pi-position on circle (0 to 2π, 0 = arbitrary start)
interval.tool_analog: the THERMOMETER. it measures HOW MUCH difference. but "twice as hot" is meaningless in Celsius.
interval.membrane_use: Shannon entropy of feeds (mean=4.638). anti-sigmoid curve values. pi-sort positions.

ratio.what: MAGNITUDES. equal spacing + true zero. ratios are meaningful.
examples: file size in bytes (0 bytes = truly empty)
ratio.tool_analog: the MICROMETER. it measures EXACTLY how much, and "twice as big" IS twice as big.
ratio.membrane_use: ALL counts, sizes, latencies, throughputs. test_density in primal-taxonomy. file bytes in strata.

distributions.concept: each distribution describes a SHAPE of data. the shape IS the fingerprint. choose the distribution that fits YOUR data, not the one you wish it was.

normal.what: the bell curve. μ ± σ. 68-95-99.7 rule. most things cluster around the mean.
normal.when: sums of many independent small effects. CLT applies.

membrane_data.where: Shannon entropy distribution across feeds (mean=4.638, std=1.086)
membrane_data.test: Shapiro-Wilk: if p > 0.05, it's normal enough
membrane_data.use: identify outlier feeds (entropy > μ+2σ or < μ-2σ)

uniform.what: flat. every value equally likely. no preference.
uniform.when: no information. maximum entropy. true randomness.

membrane_data.where: pi-sort positions (hash % 1000 → should be uniform on [0, 2π])
membrane_data.use: if pi-positions are NOT uniform, the hash is biased

power_law.what: the long tail. few giants, many dwarfs. f(x) ∝ x^(-α)
power_law.when: rich get richer. preferential attachment. scale-free networks.

membrane_data.where: file sizes (barraCuda 297K lines vs bingoCube 10K). traffic by country (US dominates). crate downloads.
membrane_data.use: predict: a few feeds will dominate attention. the 80/20 rule.

poisson.what: count of rare events in fixed time. λ = average rate.
poisson.when: counting arrivals. how many requests per hour? how many 404s per day?

membrane_data.where: hourly request counts (triad at 36/hr = λ=36). 404 probes per hour.
membrane_data.test: variance ≈ mean (if variance >> mean, it's over-dispersed → negative binomial)
membrane_data.use: detect anomalies: if actual count > 3σ above λ, something changed

exponential.what: time BETWEEN events. memoryless. λ = rate.
exponential.when: waiting time until next event. time between requests. decay.

membrane_data.where: time between git commits. time between feed updates. signal decay.
membrane_data.use: predict staleness: feeds that haven't updated in > 1/λ are likely stale

cauchy.what: the HEAVY tailed bell. no mean. no variance. undefined moments. the anarchist.
cauchy.when: ratios of normals. resonance. the ratio of two measurements each with error.

membrane_data.where: the falsification question. when you divide one uncertain measurement by another uncertain measurement, you get Cauchy. the triad analysis divided traffic/time → the ratio has no stable mean.
membrane_data.test: if your mean keeps changing with sample size, suspect Cauchy
membrane_data.use: STOP trying to compute the mean. use the median instead. Cauchy laughs at your average.

ml_uses: beware: SGD with Cauchy noise never converges

beta.what: distribution ON [0,1]. models proportions and probabilities.

membrane_data.where: sigmoid balance σ=0.972. interactive ratio 56%. Gini coefficient 0.459.
membrane_data.test: method of moments: α̂ = x̄·((x̄(1-x̄)/var)-1), β̂ = (1-x̄)·((x̄(1-x̄)/var)-1)
membrane_data.use: model the distribution of health scores across all organisms

sigmoid_itself.what: NOT a distribution — a TRANSFORM. maps (-∞,+∞) → (0,1). the squashing function.
sigmoid_itself.when: whenever you need to turn any number into a probability or health score.

membrane_data.where: σ=0.972 ecosystem balance. Berry's self-feeding sort sigma. the 50% inflection point.
membrane_data.use: the sigmoid IS the health meter. the anti-sigmoid (with valley) IS the horror meter.

the_balance_on_the_curve.concept: the sigmoid goes from - to +. the 50% point is the inflection. the 85% point is the valley. use measurement tools to know WHERE you are.

zones.action: maintain: the plateau is the goal

songBird.evidence: IN THE VALLEY: 175K lines, test_density=59.7. push to 70+ or accept the gap.

strata_gini.evidence: at the inflection. could go either way. needs rebalancing.

ml_basics_refresher.concept: machine learning IS measurement + prediction. choose the right measurement, choose the right model.
the_pipeline: 6. CRITIQUE: where on the sigmoid? in the valley?
